title: Contact Mechanics After Meniscectomy

positions.as_written: Repair where the tear allows it preserves the ring and therefore the pressure.
Resect the minimum the tear requires, and record what was resected.
Treat a young lateral meniscectomy as the worst mechanical combination and counsel accordingly.
Treat the dose response as the mechanical justification for the shift from resection to repair, and note that the shift was mechanically predicted before it was clinically demonstrated.
Repair rather than resect wherever the ring can be restored, in a young patient above all.
Offer transplantation for symptoms with an honest account of its cartilage protection evidence.
Correct alignment in a meniscus deficient compartment before expecting any restoration to hold.
